title: Use the career panel and NPC page through packaged game controls

steps.description: Open career promotion from the normal bottom navigation
Confirm the career-life panel is rendered in the existing promotion screen

steps.name: career-life-panel
steps.description: Capture employment, promotion, skill and long-term-goal UI
Open the in-game resignation review before changing employment
The review explains current employment and what changes after leaving
Dismiss the review without changing the save
Read the authoritative career relationship before the UI interaction
Return to the playable home screen, resolving any visible gameplay recap through its real close/choice button first
If resolving the critical conversation opened messenger, return to the home screen through its visible back control
Wait for the existing relationship shortcut
Open the existing NPC relationship page
Wait for the supported relationship action
Support the manager through the visible control and retry only while authoritative trust is still unchanged
Read the authoritative persisted relationship projection after the UI action
The visible support action changes memory-backed trust

steps.name: career-npc-relationship
steps.description: Capture the updated NPC relation metrics and memories
Return to the career panel to launch this employer's Fate-backed story chain
Confirm the employed player can enter the sector-specific causal event chain
Start the outsourcing chain through the visible UI and shared Fate event service
Capture the authoritative Fate run status and queue immediately after the visible trigger
Read the authoritative chain head selected for the current employer
Resolve a real critical conversation interrupting the career event through its visible choice
Acknowledge a single-choice event result through its visible modal button
Close the event result through its visible continue button
Wait for any queued message or event presentation transition to settle
The critical conversation opens messenger; return to the career page with its visible back control
Return to the home arena after leaving messenger; the shared Fate choice card is rendered there
Wait for the actual Fate choice control

steps.name: outsourcing-chain-stage-one
steps.description: Capture the first causal event and its choices
Choose the client delivery evidence route through the Fate UI
Verify the selected outcome queued the next linked event
Fate persisted the causal chain transition

steps.name: outsourcing-chain-stage-two
steps.description: Capture the next event after the player choice
